name: DeepSeek
notes: In thinking mode with tools, reasoning_content of every earlier assistant turn must be sent back or the API returns 400. Prices are the peak rates (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays); off-peak is half price. Caching is automatic and no cache write price is published, so cache write is set to the input price. Release dates come from models.dev (https://models.dev/). Context is models.dev's 1,048,576 (the docs say "1M"). The pricing page states a 384K maximum output, which is 393,216 tokens (Alibaba states 393,216 for the same models).

pricingWindows.name: DeepSeek Off-Peak
pricingWindows.notes: Every hour outside the weekday peak (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC). DeepSeek also bills Chinese public holidays off-peak in full, which a weekly schedule can't express, so Cost on those days is the peak price.

upstreamModels.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
upstreamModels.notes: Off-peak prices are in the DeepSeek Off-Peak window, with cache write at the off-peak input price. maxOutputTokens is the published maximum. Cache write is not published; caching is automatic and a first pass is billed as input, so it is set to the input price.

upstreamModels.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
upstreamModels.notes: Off-peak prices are in the DeepSeek Off-Peak window, with cache write at the off-peak input price. Vision not supported. maxOutputTokens is the published maximum. Cache write is not published; caching is automatic and a first pass is billed as input, so it is set to the input price.
